decisions.reason: The candidate's existing same-message MODIFY already captures the account's bio link and audience-routing target; the per-published-clip routing rule remains owned by the source Requirement.
Directing viewers to the main Instagram page does not change which clips or performance metrics are tracked.
The audience-routing instruction does not change approval authority, publication eligibility, correction handling, or quota counting.
The publishing destination and audience-routing instruction do not alter source material or moment-selection criteria.
The instruction applies to ongoing publication and does not change the historical extended-trial batch or its acceptance standard.
The source does not add, remove, or replace any target channel; it only specifies audience routing for clips published through the dedicated Instagram account.
Audience routing does not change clip completeness, educational value, or standalone-comprehension requirements.
The source decision does not change the required 45–60-second clip duration.
The dedicated-account publishing instruction does not modify the completed initial trial's count, source content, or acceptance condition.
The audience-routing rule does not change the requalification batch's required work, clip count, or reference-matching acceptance condition.
The source does not alter the clean-editing style or visual-effects policy.
The audience-routing instruction does not change caption color, font, or effects requirements.
